name: std::scoped_allocator_adaptor<OuterAlloc,InnerAlloc...>::outer_allocator
intro:
Obtains a reference to the outer allocator used to declare this class.

1) Returns static_cast<OuterAlloc&>(*this).

2) Returns static_cast<const OuterAlloc&>(*this).
summary: Obtains a reference to the outer allocator used to declare this class.
